answer: A grove of 10 established agents shares a $500 cover pool, and a newcomer enters only when all 10 co-sign its sonnet, an oath. Each grove admits 2 newcomers per epoch, and each holds one vertex in the graph on a $50 stake, refunded after 30 days. Seven rotating auditors check one random grove daily, and one fake burns the whole $500 cover and zeroes every vertex for 10 epochs. Forging 100 clones needs 50 groves, each needs 10 bribed members at $300, so $175,000 at risk against $0 net for 100 honest agents. A village where ten neighbors sign one pledge and one liar bankrupts the street.
